test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: National income received by the households is called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**personal income.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Personal income:-**

 
 
• It is the national income received by the **households.**
 
• It includes all the income earned by individuals from various sources such as **wages, salaries, rent, interest, and profit.**
 
• Personal income can vary widely from person to person, depending on factors such as education, occupation, and location. In general, people with higher levels of education and more skilled occupations tend to have higher personal incomes.
 
• People who live in urban areas also tend to have higher personal incomes than people who live in rural areas.
 
• Here are some examples of personal income:-
 
 
• Wages and salaries
 
• Bonuses and commissions
 
• Investment income (e.g., dividends, interest, capital gains)
 
• Social security benefits
 
• Pension income
 
• Unemployment benefits
 
• Disability benefits
 
• Child support
 
• Alimony
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Informations__**

 
• **Domestic income:-**

 
 
• It** **is an important measure of a **country's economic activity and growth**.
 
• It is used to calculate the **Gross Domestic Product (GDP) **of a country.
 
 
 
• **Professional income:-**
 
 
• It​ is a subset of personal income and is earned by individuals with specialized skills and knowledge.
 
• It is usually higher than the income earned by i**ndividuals in other professions**.
 
 
 
• **Disposable income:-**
 
 
• It is an important measure of the **purchasing power** of households in a country.
 
• It is used to calculate the **Consumer Price Index **(CPI) which is a measure of inflation.
